name: Reviewed local YARA pattern
description: An approved YARA-X rule matched file bytes. A pattern match supports triage and does not establish malware or execution.
false_positives: Benign test markers and broadly written patterns

name: Provider detection counts
description: Third-party provider returned detection counts for a hash/IP. Suppliers are one supporting signal, not independent confirmations.
false_positives: Vendor false positives and stale reputation

name: Reviewed local IOC match
description: An unexpired operator-reviewed local indicator matched metadata. Review provenance and expiry before action.
false_positives: Shared infrastructure and outdated analyst feeds

name: Frozen baseline deviation
description: A feature deviated from a sufficiently populated frozen host reference. Rarity is low-confidence context.
false_positives: Software updates and ordinary new activity
